text:
maria: FYI I pushed a lightweight probechain sampler to prod for 1h to get token-level TTFT vs decode attribution across routes. goal: surface any kernel handoff regressions and KV-cache mismatches. dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/probechain-token-attr :eyes:

sam: nice — what's the sampling rate and expected overhead?

maria: sampling = 2% global, 10% on high-traffic /chat route for better signal. measured overhead ~0.6% cpu and ~0.5% p95 token latency in staging. config snippet:```yaml
probechain:
  sample_rate: 0.02
  route_overrides:
    /chat: 0.1
  emit_metrics: [ttft, decode, kernel_copy, kv_lookup, hw_wait]
```

kei: seeing a small p95 bump on /chat in the new probe window (live). can someone attach the flamegraph?

perf-bot: uploaded artifact: s3://perf-artifacts/probechain/1756400123/flame.html (sha256: b7f9...)

alex: that flame looks like added memcpy on the kernel path after the last microkernel refactor (commit: d1e8f7). suspect the kernel-copy attribution is now more visible.

maria: good catch. plan: annotate the dashboard with the d1e8f7 deploy time and correlate token attribution slices (prequeue / kernel_copy / decode). created annotation at 1756400300.

jonah: can we also break out KV hit-rate by model shard? current per-route kv_hit is useful but hides hot-shard skew.

qa: is it safe to leave probechain on for longer? we need to ensure SLOs. My synthetic run showed <1% CPU, p99 unaffected, but p95 moved ~1.1% on worst-case.

maria: agree on cautious roll: keep 2% global for next 2 hours. rollback if p95 > 2% above baseline for 5 consecutive mins. I added an alert rule: `probechain:latency_regress > 2pct for 5m`

sam: add a CI microbench that reproduces the kernel-copy path with 128 token sequences so we have a pre-commit check.

maria: will add a synthetic probe test in eng-runtime CI and a dashboard tile with per-route p50/p95/p99 and token-attribution waterfall. checklist I'm following: 1) gather 1h samples, 2) compare pre-deploy baseline, 3) annotate deploys, 4) run CI microbench, 5) open PR for kernel fix if regression confirmed.

kei: ping me when you have the CI test. I'll run a handful of manual runs against a canary pool.

alex: if we confirm memcpy regression, I have a tiny patch that avoids an extra copy in the handoff path. low-risk but needs perf validation.

maria: perfect — I'll start the CI test and keep the probe up for 2h. will post a short summary in ~90m with heatmaps and route breakdown. thanks all :thumbsup:
